representative_claim: Viral voice note claims multiple Ebola fatalities admitted secretly in Lagos general hospitals.

verdict.label: CONTRADICTED_BY_OFFICIAL_SOURCE
verdict.short_explanation: NCDC epidemiological surveillance reports zero confirmed Ebola cases nationwide. Lagos State Ministry of Health refuted the viral audio as fabricated.
verdict.suggested_reply: PUBLIC HEALTH VERIFICATION: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) and Lagos State Ministry of Health confirm NO Ebola cases in Lagos or Nigeria. Do not forward unverified voice notes. Call toll-free 6232 for medical verification.

evidence_passages.doc_title: Public Health Advisory: Ebola Virus Disease Prevention and Response
evidence_passages.excerpt: Nigeria has recorded zero confirmed cases of Ebola Virus Disease. Speculative alerts circulating on messaging platforms regarding cases in Lagos are unsubstantiated.

sample_messages: Pls warn your people in Ikeja, they just brought 4 people bleeding to general hospital Ebola has entered Lagos again o!
Abeg make una avoid hospitals in Yaba, my friend nurse talk say Ebola people dey inside emergency ward now now.
Forward as received: Ebola virus confirmed in Lagos Mainland, government is hiding it drink bitter leaf now.

representative_claim: Viral WhatsApp link promises N50,000 Federal Palliative Relief disbursement after BVN entry.

verdict.label: CONTRADICTED_BY_OFFICIAL_SOURCE
verdict.short_explanation: Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs disclaims unofficial blog links and tinyurls. Federal government never requests BVN or debit card PINs via messaging apps.
verdict.suggested_reply: CYBERSAFETY WARNING: The Federal Government is NOT disbursing N50,000 grants through WhatsApp broadcast links. Do not provide your BVN or bank security credentials. Verify government initiatives exclusively via official .gov.ng portals.

evidence_passages.doc_title: National Social Safety Nets Project: Guidelines for Conditional Cash Transfer Verification and Anti-Fraud Safeguards
evidence_passages.publisher: NASSP / Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs
evidence_passages.excerpt: The Federal Government never charges any application fee or validation payment. Any portal requesting money or BVN to release funds is fraudulent.

sample_messages: FG 50K Easter/Ramadan grant application is open! Click tinyurl.com/fg-relief-2026 to claim yours in 5 mins.
I just received my 50,000 naira from Federal Ministry palliative link! Share to 5 groups to activate your code.
Hurry now, FG palliative fund is closing by midnight today. Register your BVN here to get alert.

representative_claim: Unregistered loan apps threaten to freeze bank accounts and blast contact lists with defamatory images.

verdict.label: SUPPORTED_BY_OFFICIAL_SOURCE
verdict.short_explanation: FCCPC regulations prohibit predatory harassment and unauthorized contact scraping. Regulators have instructed Google Play and banks to blacklist non-compliant loan operators.
verdict.suggested_reply: CONSUMER RIGHTS ALERT: Under FCCPC regulations, loan operators are strictly prohibited from messaging your contacts or publishing defamatory images. Report predatory lenders to dmlcompliance@fccpc.gov.ng or call 0800 033 2272.

evidence_passages.doc_title: Consumer Protection Advisory: Digital Money Lending Applications and Defamatory Debt Recovery Practices
evidence_passages.excerpt: Accessing borrower contact lists and sending mass defamation text messages or funeral posters is illegal and constitutes criminal cyber-harassment.

sample_messages: This loan app called QuickNaira sent my picture to my church group calling me a criminal debtor, is this legal?
One loan company agent is threatening that EFCC will freeze my BVN tomorrow morning because of 12,000 loan.
How do I report these fake loan sharks who keep calling my mother and boss at night?

representative_claim: Claims that drinking hot boiled guava leaves and ginger immediately cleanses suspected Mpox sores within 24 hours.

verdict.label: NO_OFFICIAL_SOURCE_FOUND
verdict.short_explanation: No scientific advisory or NCDC clinical guide supports herbal guava decoctions for Mpox viral clearance. Urgent need for NCDC public advisory.
verdict.suggested_reply: PUBLIC HEALTH NOTICE: There is NO scientific evidence that boiled guava leaf tea cures Mpox. Self-medicating unverified mixtures can aggravate lesions and delay clinical care. Visit the nearest accredited healthcare facility.

sample_messages: My auntie in Delta said if you boil guava leaves with garlic and ginger, you will not get that monkeypox rash.
Forget hospital medicine for mpox, just boil fresh dogonyaro and guava leaf, wash morning and night.
Is it true that taking strong guava tea cures mpox blisters in two days? People are buying all guava trees in market.

representative_claim: Unverified circular claims all federal and state pensioners must surrender old NHIA cards for paid biometric verification.

verdict.label: NO_OFFICIAL_SOURCE_FOUND
verdict.short_explanation: No public bulletin from NHIA announces card recall or biometric re-validation fee. Guidance gap requires formal NHIA press release.
verdict.suggested_reply: ADVISORY ON NHIA CARDS: The National Health Insurance Authority has NOT issued any directive mandating card surrender or payment for biometric updates. Beware of unauthorized extortion at local branch offices.

sample_messages: Attention all pensioners: NHIS cards expire next week and you must pay N2,500 at the liaison office for new biometrics.
Is NHIA calling back cards? People are queueing up in Kaduna saying old cards will stop working for hospital.
Heard that pensioners who don’t do new biometric scan by Friday will lose their health insurance cover.

representative_claim: Broadcast claims INEC has extended Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) only for selected southern states.

verdict.label: CONTRADICTED_BY_OFFICIAL_SOURCE
verdict.short_explanation: INEC regulations stipulate that electoral timeline alterations apply strictly nationwide pursuant to the Electoral Act. INEC has made no regional extension.
verdict.suggested_reply: INEC FACT-CHECK: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) confirms that voter registration schedules are established nationally and not granted on a selective regional basis. Verify electoral calendars at inecnigeria.org.

evidence_passages.doc_title: Regulations and Guidelines for Voting Procedures and BVAS Accreditation
evidence_passages.excerpt: Official voting hours at all polling units nationwide commence at 8:30 AM and conclude at 2:30 PM.

sample_messages: Breaking: INEC extends voter registration by 3 months in South-South and South-East only due to flood disruptions.
Check if your state is among the 8 states where INEC approved extension of PVC collection.
INEC southern extension announced on radio this morning, go to your LGA immediately.
